evaluations.note: 9 on the reference machine: example 01's search with the parametric cohesive-energy script. BFGS reaches the upper bound RCUT2B = 6.0 at eval 7 (the best, 1.015561e-01), takes the one-sided gradient there (evals 8-9), and its next step cannot move the point: the line search is not run, and the objective-delta test ends the search ("DLIB:BFGS: FTOL_ABS reached"). 1.5.0's fingerprint had 16 evaluations.

tolerance_rationale: Best loss, components and RCUT2B are pinned at the default tolerances, and the evaluation count exactly: as in example 01, the optimum is on the upper bound RCUT2B = 6.0 (eval 7), BFGS takes the one-sided gradient there (evals 8-9), and its next step cannot move the point, so its line search is not run and the objective-delta test ends the search, "DLIB:BFGS: FTOL_ABS reached", after 9 evaluations. As in example 01, no point is evaluated twice, so no decision of the search compares two relaxations of one point.
